description: This file is a PHP source class definition for the 'Location' controller within the 'Localisation' namespace in the OpenCart admin module. It handles CRUD operations for location entities, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting locations, and manages form display and data processing for location details.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Controller class managing CRUD operations and form handling for localisation locations in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method handling the display and processing of the locations list page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of locations in a JSON format for AJAX or other API use.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal function that retrieves a paginated list of locations based on sorting, ordering, and filtering parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a location.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a location.
